item.title: Deadly Israeli Strike on Gaza Raises Doubts About Trump Peace Plan
item.description: A day after President Trump’s envoy, Jared Kushner, visited Israel to advance a stalled plan for demilitarizing and rebuilding Gaza, the Israeli military said it targeted Hamas commanders.

item.title: Iran war: Trump tries economic pressure — again
item.description: Iran has survived decades of sanctions. Faced with more, it is likely to escalate rather than surrender, analysts said.

item.title: How the Iran War Made Africa’s Richest Man Even Richer
item.description: Africans have turned to one of their own for fuel as the world’s supplies run low. But they are not the only ones with the continent’s richest man on speed dial.

item.title: Ukraine’s Ex-Defense Minister Calls for Election, Cementing Break With Zelensky
item.description: Mykhailo Fedorov, a popular young leader who was fired last month, said Russia should not be allowed to dictate when Ukrainians can choose their next government.

item.title: How Israel’s Financial Chokehold Is Stifling the West Bank Economy
item.description: Intensifying restrictions have hit every part of the territory’s dealings, spurring worries about whether the Palestinian Authority can remain solvent.

item.title: Israel Strikes Air Base in Syria, Drawing Ire From the U.S.
item.description: The attack was the latest in a series of Israeli military interventions in Syria over the past two years.

item.title: Chocó, Colombia, Faces Deeper Hardship After an Earthquake
item.description: In Chocó, a remote region, “pain, hunger and homelessness await” survivors of last week’s earthquake, the governor said. Shakira visited to help draw awareness.

item.title: At Ex-Premier Zhu Rongji’s Funeral, China’s Past Shadows Its Present
item.description: Beijing wants to portray today’s China as carrying forward Zhu Rongji’s era of growth, but for many Chinese, the optimism of that time has since faded.

item.title: A Mother’s Quest to Rescue Her Son From Russian-Occupied Ukraine
item.description: They made a risky bid to reunite after three years of separation, illness and deprivation — the kind of ordeal suffered by many thousands of families torn apart by the war in eastern Ukraine.

item.title: מתקיפות ישראליות בלבנון נהרגו 9, אומרים גורמי בריאות
item.description: משרד הבריאות הלבנוני אמר כי מספר ילדים נהרגו בשביתה במהלך הלילה, אחד הפיגועים הקטלניים ביותר מזה חודשים. צבא ישראל אמר שהוא מכוון לתשתיות של חיזבאללה.
